reviews.quote: Centered around a gorgeous 16-inch OLED display, this Yoga laptop provides the performance and build that graphics pros demand.

praises: CNET Editors' Choice config: the exact Ultra 9 + RTX 5050 + 32GB + 1TB build reviewers validated
3.2K Tandem OLED sustains 1,600-nit HDR peaks — the display is the reason people buy this SKU
Arrow Lake-H Ultra 9 handles sustained exports far better than the Lunar-Lake-class Slims
